title: The Organization of Innovation: Incomplete Contracts and the Outsourcing Decision
title_zh: 创新的组织：不完全合同与外包决策
authors: Thomas Jungbauer, Sean Nicholson, June Pan, Michael Waldman, Lucy Xiaolu Wang
abstract: Why do firms outsource research and development (R&D) for some products while conducting R&D in-house for similar ones? An innovating firm risks cannibalizing its existing products. The more profitable these products, the more the firm wants to limit cannibalization. We apply this logic to the organization of R&D by introducing a novel theoretical model in which developing in-house provides the firm more control over the new product’s location in product space. An empirical analysis of our testable predictions using pharmaceutical data concerning patents, patent expiration, and outsourcing at various stages of the R&D process supports our theoretical approach. (JEL D21, D22, L22, L24, L65, O31, O34)
abstract_zh: 为什么企业会对某些产品外包研发，而对类似产品进行内部研发？创新企业面临蚕食现有产品的风险。现有产品利润越高，企业就越想限制这种蚕食。我们将这一逻辑应用于研发组织方式，提出了一个新颖的理论模型：内部研发能让企业更好地控制新产品在产品空间中的定位。我们利用制药行业关于专利、专利到期以及研发各阶段外包的数据，对可检验的预测进行了实证分析，结果支持了我们的理论方法。（JEL D21, D22, L22, L24, L65, O31, O34）

title: Cross-Border Spillovers: How U.S. Monetary Conditions Affect M&As Around the World
title_zh: 跨境溢出效应：美国货币政策如何影响全球并购活动
authors: Bergant, Katharina, Mishra, Prachi, Rajan, Raghuram, Pinzon-Puerto, Freddy
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study how U.S. monetary policy shocks transmit to cross-border merger and acquisition (M&A) activity. Using country- and firmlevel data, tighter U.S. policy is shown to reduce both the value and the number of cross-border deals. The effects are especially pronounced for acquirer firms with larger foreign-currency liabilities, consistent with a net worth channel. Reflecting agency motives for acquisitions, deals announced under more accommodative U.S. conditions underperform ex post, indicating potential capital misallocation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究美国货币政策冲击如何传导至跨境并购活动。基于国家和企业层面数据，我们发现美国政策收紧会同时降低跨境交易的价值与数量。对于外币负债规模较大的收购方企业，这一效应尤为显著，与净资产渠道的传导机制相吻合。反映并购中的代理动机，在美国政策宽松时期宣布的交易在事后表现欠佳，表明可能存在资本错配现象。

authors: Agha A. Akram, Gabriella Fleischman, Reshmaan N. Hussam, Akib Khan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How does a person’s own learning experience affect their ability to learn from others? We conduct a field experiment on chlorination in Pakistan, where randomized “learning-arm” households use a tool to track their children’s diarrhea before and after chlorine distribution. Learning-arm households with learning-arm neighbors chlorinate significantly more one year after the withdrawal of the tool, with children’s health improving by 0.08 SD relative to all other households receiving chlorine. Neither learning households without learning-arm neighbors, nor non-learning households with learning-arm neighbors, exhibit sustained behavior change, results which have significant implications for intervention and evaluation design.
abstract_zh: 个人的学习经历如何影响其向他人学习的能力？我们在巴基斯坦开展了一项关于氯消毒的实地实验，随机分配的“学习组”家庭使用工具记录其子女在氯消毒前后的腹泻情况。一年后，当该工具被撤除时，拥有学习组邻居的学习组家庭的氯消毒使用率显著更高，其子女健康状况相较于其他所有接受氯消毒的家庭提升了0.08个标准差。既无学习组邻居的学习组家庭，亦无学习组邻居的非学习组家庭，均未表现出持续的行为改变。这一结果对于干预措施设计与评估方法具有重要启示。

title: Addressing the EU’s fiscal dilemma: From ex-post transfers to ex-ante resilience
title_zh: 应对欧盟财政困境：从事后转移支付转向事前韧性
authors: Georg Kirchsteiger, Martin Larch, Georg Kirchsteiger; Martin Larch
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The EU’s fiscal governance framework was built to contribute to overall macroeconomic stability through compliance with fiscal rules and the commitment not to bail-out countries in trouble. Yet successive crises have revealed vulnerabilities under systemic stress: countries with a propensity to run deficits push frugal ones into ex-post bail-out arrangements to avert collapse, thus undermining the ex-ante credibility of the framework. The absence of a permanent, preventive instrument forces the Union to oscillate between leniency and emergency intervention. A permanent RRF-like mechanism - linking EU funds to reform and investment projects - offers an incentive compatible solution and a possible bridge to a larger EU budget.
abstract_zh: 欧盟的财政治理框架旨在通过遵守财政规则以及不救助陷入困境国家的承诺，促进整体宏观经济稳定。然而，接连不断的危机揭示了系统性压力下的脆弱性：倾向于赤字运行的国家迫使节俭国家在事后采取救助安排以避免崩溃，从而削弱了该框架的事前可信度。由于缺乏永久性的预防工具，欧盟不得不在宽松政策与紧急干预之间摇摆。一个类似复苏与韧性基金的永久性机制——将欧盟资金与改革和投资项目挂钩——提供了一种激励相容的解决方案，并可能成为迈向更大规模欧盟预算的桥梁。

title: The Return to College, Marriage, and Intergenerational Mobility
title_zh: 大学教育、婚姻与代际流动的回报
authors: Eric D Gould
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: This paper empirically examines the idea that the increasing return to college is reducing intergenerational mobility by differentially impacting the investments in children by parents across education groups. A larger return to college will create stronger incentives to invest in children by parents with more education, if educated parents have a comparative advantage in producing human capital in children. Given the importance of a two-parent household on childhood development, marital status is a critical investment decision that parents consider. Relative to less-educated mothers, the analysis shows that educated mothers in states with a larger increase in the return to education are more likely to be married, less likely to divorce, have a more educated spouse, and own more valuable houses. Their children also have relatively higher test scores in 8th grade and rates of college completion. These results are consistent with the increasing return to college differentially affecting the incentives for parental investments in children, which in turn, creates greater disparities in childhood conditions and reduces intergenerational mobility in education.
abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了如下观点：大学教育回报率的上升通过不同教育背景的父母对子女投资行为的差异化影响，降低了代际流动性。若受教育程度较高的父母在子女人力资本培养方面具有比较优势，则大学教育回报率的提升将更强烈地激励他们增加对子女的投资。鉴于双亲家庭对儿童发展的重要性，婚姻状况是父母考虑的关键投资决策。分析表明，相较于低学历母亲，在受教育回报率增幅较大的州，高学历母亲更可能处于已婚状态、离婚概率更低、配偶受教育程度更高、且拥有更高价值的房产。其子女在八年级的考试成绩及大学完成率也相对更高。这些结果与大学教育回报率上升对父母投资激励的差异化影响相一致，这种影响进而加剧了儿童成长环境的差距，并降低了教育代际流动性。

title: Fragmentation of Shareholder Power
title_zh: 股东权力的碎片化
authors: Andrey Malenko, Nadya Malenko, Anton Tsoy
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The asset management industry is increasingly shifting toward tailored portfolios, fund proliferation, and decentralization of stewardship—trends partly driven by growing heterogeneity in investor preferences. While these developments better align investment products with investor demands, they also reshape ownership structures, potentially leading to more fragmented ownership and weaker managerial oversight. We develop a framework to evaluate these trade-offs and show that fund proliferation does not necessarily weaken governance: Stronger incentives for asset managers and concentrated portfolios of specialized funds can offset these effects, especially when investor preferences are intense. However, strong investor preferences can also induce asset managers to compete on a new margin—granting investors control by decentralizing stewardship and adopting pass-through voting—without internalizing the associated governance costs.
abstract_zh: 资产管理行业正日益转向定制化投资组合、基金数量激增以及管理权分散化——这些趋势部分源于投资者偏好的异质性增强。虽然这些发展使投资产品与投资者需求更加匹配，但也重塑了所有权结构，可能导致所有权更加分散、管理层监督弱化。我们构建了一个评估这些权衡关系的分析框架，并发现基金数量激增未必会削弱公司治理：更强的资产管理人激励措施以及专业基金的集中化投资组合可以抵消这些影响，尤其在投资者偏好强烈时更为显著。然而，强烈的投资者偏好也可能促使资产管理人在新维度上展开竞争——通过分散管理权和采用传递投票机制将控制权让渡给投资者——却未将相应的治理成本内部化。

title: Taking geopolitically motivated US swap lines too far would harm the dollar and Fed independence
title_zh: 将地缘政治驱动的美国互换额度推得太远将损害美元和美联储独立性
authors: Mazarei, Adnan, Obstfeld, Maurice
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.
abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪以来，美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但适当的流动性注入模式取决于经济、金融和地缘政治背景。当地缘政治关切占主导地位时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道，而美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，并更少受短期外交政策动机的影响。迄今为止，法律、规范及政府间谅解在一定程度上约束了这些对外贷款渠道的政治滥用，但已无法假定各方会继续遵守，因此需要更正式的防护措施。

title: The relationship between intergenerational mobility and equality of opportunity
title_zh: 代际流动与机会平等的关系
authors: Adrian Adermon, Gunnar Brandén, Martin Nybom
abstract: Among economists, the analysis of social mobility and the role of parental background is largely carried out in two separate strands of research. The intergenerational mobility literature estimates parent–child persistence in some outcome of interest, such as income. In contrast, the equality of opportunity literature is rooted in a normative framework, and has only more recently started generating empirical evidence. Intergenerational mobility regressions are relatively straightforward to estimate, but their normative implications are less obvious. Measures of equality of opportunity have a policy‐relevant interpretation, but are very data‐demanding, requiring a large set of observable determinants of socioeconomic status for large samples. But maybe the two approaches capture similar dynamics? We compare the approaches by estimating both equality of opportunity and intergenerational mobility measures – as well as sibling correlations – across 16 birth cohorts and 126 Swedish local labor markets. Using these estimates, we find that the different measures correlate strongly, suggesting that (variation in) intergenerational mobility is indeed informative about equality of opportunity.
abstract_zh: 在经济学界，对社会流动性和父母背景作用的分析主要分为两个独立的研究方向。代际流动性文献估计了父母与子女在收入等特定结果变量上的持续性关联。相比之下，机会平等文献植根于规范性框架，直到近期才开始产生实证证据。代际流动性回归的估计相对直接，但其规范性含义却不甚明确。机会平等指标具有政策相关的解释意义，但对数据要求极高，需要大样本中大量可观测的社会经济地位决定因素。然而，这两种方法是否捕捉到了相似的动态特征？我们通过估算16个出生队列和126个瑞典地方劳动力市场的机会平等指标、代际流动性指标以及同胞相关性，对这两种方法进行了比较。基于这些估计，我们发现不同指标之间存在强相关性，这表明代际流动性的（变化）确实能够反映机会平等状况。

title: Self‐Fundamentals, Cross‐Fundamentals, and Exchange Rate Predictions
title_zh: 自我基本面、交叉基本面与汇率预测
authors: QIN WANG, YU REN
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: In this paper, we propose incorporating both self‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of two economies in one currency pair, and cross‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of other major economies, to forecast exchange rates in line with the theory of “third‐country effects” of Berg and Mark (2015). We utilize the Mallows model averaging method proposed in Hansen (2007) to optimally combine the predictions provided by fundamental submodels. We find that our approach significantly outperforms the random walk and the alternatives for one‐month‐ahead predictions and that both the self‐ and cross‐fundamentals play important roles in prediction. Furthermore, according to our prediction, we obtain meaningful investment profit trading on currencies and bonds.
abstract_zh: 本文提出将“自身基本面”（定义为货币对中两个经济体的基本面）与“交叉基本面”（定义为其他主要经济体的基本面）相结合，以预测汇率，这与Berg和Mark（2015）提出的“第三国效应”理论一致。我们采用Hansen（2007）提出的Mallows模型平均方法，对基本面子模型提供的预测进行最优组合。研究发现，该方法在提前一个月的预测中显著优于随机游走模型及其他替代模型，且自身基本面与交叉基本面均在预测中发挥重要作用。此外，基于我们的预测，在货币和债券交易中可获得显著的投资利润。

title: Interim agreements
title_zh: 临时协议
authors: Dov Samet
abstract: Processes of bargaining are studied in which the players reach interim agreements that serve as status quo points for further bargaining. This is modeled in Nash’s setup of bargaining problems, where the solution is a time parameterized path of interim agreements rather than a single point. We characterize path solutions for linear problems that satisfy the axioms of restarting and covariance , and show that if a Pareto efficient agreement is not reached immediately, then it is never reached in finite time. Adding the axioms of individual rationality , relevance , and monotonicity , we characterize the family of continuous Raiffa solutions and show that these solutions converge to a Pareto efficient agreement but never reach it in finite time. Finally, if a deadline is added to the bargaining problem, and the speed of bargaining is proportionally inverse to the deadline, then a Pareto efficient agreement is reached exactly at the deadline.
